content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the birth promise for creating a node in a new change — without it, writing is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Identity is where the elaboration meets the birth; the gate keeps the use sound without testing the path itself.
